coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three tasks. The four required constants and the exact dependent-variable specification are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, fixed random seeds, or the shared prompting-framework installation and BoT repository configuration. Uses six trials instead of 10 repeated runs per task. Measures wall-clock seconds and proposes an unspecified logarithmic transformation rather than explicitly base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance. Also adds CoT and auxiliary outcomes beyond the reference design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time comparison nor the task-specific logarithmic values. The design's hypotheses do not substitute for a conclusion; its prediction that BoT is slower than PAL on every task also conflicts with the reference Game of 24 values (BoT 5.17 versus PAL 5.5).
